review.finding: The 89,166-triangle candidate preserves the dense dome ribs and curvature, column and arch profiles, statue silhouette and drapery, banners, steps and rear rotunda far better than V4.
review.knownLimitation: Micro-relief belongs in the dense-donor bake; the starting UV has one zero-length tangent corner that must be repaired or excluded and revalidated after export.
review.nextGate: Meshy PBR retexture on the accepted geometry, then dense-donor normal/AO bake and fresh Blender export/reimport validation.
